svg.title: LH002 time map: ten repositories, 26 March to 22 April 2026
svg.desc: One lane per repository. Each cell is one UTC day, shaded by commits that day from git. An orange line marks mcp 1.27.0 on PyPI; diamonds mark days with a manifest dependency change; orange dots mark the moment a repository's manifest or lockfile first holds mcp 1.27.0.
svg.text: Time map: commits by day, the library release and dependency changes
Ten GitHub repositories (the mcp library and nine PyPI dependents), 26 March to 22 April 2026, UTC days. Git history read 26 September 2026.
